prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: selected implementation prototype for BookStark Flutter Android, local AI save-result recovery page.
Primary request: Create one clean high-fidelity flat app prototype image containing two portrait mobile screens side by side, each approximately 390 by 844 design pixels. This is a Chinese productivity/knowledge app. Match existing project system: pale slate background #F6F8FC, white cards, 12dp corners, 24dp page gutters, primary blue #2563EB, slate #0F172A text, restrained amber notices, generous 48dp touch targets. No device hardware, no photography, no perspective, no decorative illustrations. Clear readable Chinese typography.
Screen left, small outside caption “找到保存记录”. Top app bar with back arrow, exact title “核对保存结果”. Small subtitle “本地空间”. Amber notice card exact title “上次保存结果待确认”, body “先核对找到的资料，再确认保存结果。” White record card with small green check and exact text “已找到本地笔记”, title “冬日阅读清单”, metadata “Markdown 笔记 · 今天 14:32”. White read-only preview card labelled “当前资料” and quiet badge “只读”, render a bold Markdown heading “冬日阅读清单” and two numbered lines “阅读一个章节” and “记录三个问题”. Below preview text “与上次保存内容一致”. Bottom full-width blue primary button “确认已保存”, outlined secondary button “打开资料”.
Screen right, outside caption “未找到保存记录”. Same app bar title “核对保存结果”, subtitle “本地空间”. Amber notice exact title “暂未找到保存记录”, body “原编辑草稿已保留，请确认后再处理。” White read-only draft card labelled “原编辑草稿”, title “每周阅读安排”, two bullets “周三阅读散文” and “周末整理摘录”, small amber badge “尚未确认保存”. Bottom primary outlined action “放弃这次保存尝试”, secondary text action “返回核对”. Small footer “资料与草稿都会保留”.
Constraints: Functional mobile UI, exact Chinese copy, consistent alignment, real text hierarchy, all screen content fully in frame. No SQL, hashes, database schema numbers, raw IDs, API keys, debug text or fake completed state on the right screen. Avoid dramatic shadows, gradients, extra branding, extra screens and extra actions.
revision_instruction: Remove the literal Markdown # prefix from the left preview heading; render 冬日阅读清单 as a heading. Preserve the rest.
